description: This file defines the ResourceManager class responsible for managing resources like SQL queries and file usage within the SuiteCRM project. It implements singleton pattern, observer setup, and notification mechanisms.

classes.name: ResourceManager
classes.description: Singleton class responsible for resource management operations such as observer setup, notification, and limit enforcement.

methods.name: getInstance
methods.description: Returns the singleton instance of ResourceManager.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Sets up resource observers based on the module, config, and environment.

methods.name: notifyObservers
methods.description: Notifies registered observers with a message, typically indicating resource limits.

methods.name: getObservers
methods.description: Returns the list of configured observer instances.
